issues.description: Numeric threshold in the solution for Aufgabe 06 does not match the problem statement. The problem requires selecting Gemeinden with more than 100,000 male and more than 100,000 female inhabitants, but the solution uses > 10,000 for both conditions. This discrepancy will make the solution and any automated checks inconsistent with the task description and could confuse students about the intended filter criteria.
issues.suggested_fix: Update the solution's WHERE clause to use the 100,000 threshold specified in the problem statement, e.g. WHERE einwohner_m > 100000 AND einwohner_w > 100000, so the reference solution matches the task description and automated checks.
